archive_workflow: Locate original treaty NAID 124047004 and treaty-specific reserved land
Search Creek reservation rolls by person/reservation identifier
Extract legal land description; survey township range section
Locate 1834–1857 transaction register entry: grantor, grantee, amount, date, purchaser
Check treaty Article III certification, presidential approval and payment evidence
Follow patent and county deed transfers by legal description, including heirs and estate changes
Reconcile 1844 individual judgment and 1973 tribal award/offsets and later final payments
Define possible in-kind restoration, alternative compensation and verified loss of use; consult current rightsholders
Use unknown (null) for all outstanding balances until audit completed
rules: Do not count collective land cession and same parcel reservation twice
Do not confuse treaty benefits promised with benefits received
Do not infer descendants or successor rights from surname alone
A subsequent deed does not necessarily cure defects in a prior conveyance
No 13.1M VSL multiplication for land or labor asset claims
No retroactive compounding without base-year principal, date and rate
Legal decision can recognize liability without setting the final award or documenting payment
